title: A lifted idempotent of A[T]/(f) lifts the coprime factorization of f
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal contained in the Jacobson radical of $A$, $f\in A[T]$ monic with image $\overline f\in(A/I)[T]$, and $\overline f=g_0h_0$ with $g_0,h_0\in(A/I)[T]$ monic and generating the unit ideal of $(A/I)[T]$. Let $B=A[T]/(f)$ and identify $B/IB$ with $(A/I)[T]/(\overline f)$ (reduction of coefficients). Let $\bar e\in B/IB$ be the idempotent with $\bar e\equiv1$ modulo $g_0$ and $\bar e\equiv0$ modulo $h_0$ (the element $(1,0)$ under the Chinese remainder isomorphism $(A/I)[T]/(\overline f)\cong(A/I)[T]/(g_0)\times(A/I)[T]/(h_0)$). If $e\in B$ is an idempotent whose image in $B/IB$ is $\bar e$, then there are monic polynomials $g,h\in A[T]$ with $f=gh$ whose images in $(A/I)[T]$ are $g_0$ and $h_0$. (In Stacks' proof, $g$ and $h$ are the characteristic polynomials of multiplication by $T$ on the finite locally free $A$-modules $eB$ and $(1-e)B$, which have constant ranks $\deg g_0$ and $\deg h_0$.)
